import importlib.util, importlib.machinery, json
loader = importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader("runmod", "/app/submit/run")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader("runmod", loader)
R = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); loader.exec_module(R)

def comp(fib, caps, ms):
    return R.handle_compile({"op":"compile","fib":fib,"capacities":caps,"max_stride":ms})
def look(img, addrs):
    return R.handle_lookup({"op":"lookup","image":img,"addresses":addrs})

# empty fib
img=comp([], [10**6]*4, 32)
print("empty compile", img["status"], img["used_bits"])
print("empty lookup", look(img, ["::","2001:db8::1"]))
# only /0
img=comp([{"prefix":"::/0","hop":5}], [10**6]*4,32)
print("root lookup", look(img, ["::","ffff::1"]))
# adjacent networks /1
img=comp([{"prefix":"::/1","hop":1},{"prefix":"8000::/1","hop":2}], [10**6]*4,32)
print("adjacent", look(img, ["::1","7fff::","8000::","ffff::"]))
# /128 exact and neighbor
img=comp([{"prefix":"2001:db8::/32","hop":8},{"prefix":"2001:db8::1/128","hop":9}], [10**6]*4,32)
print("deep", look(img, ["2001:db8::1","2001:db8::2","2001:db9::"]))
